header: Reasons on one side, figures on the other
lead: For figures that need an explanation next to them.
bodytext: The text column makes the argument and the figures column supports it. A switch swaps the two halves. In the source order the text always comes first, because figures without context are just a list of numbers.
note: Give the reporting period here, so readers do not assume the figures are current.

metrics.title: Figures, minimum
metrics.text: For a single figure, use Big Number.

metrics.title: Figures, maximum
metrics.text: With more than six, the column gets longer than the text.
